pages.title: Quantum Error-Correction Core
pages.text: A core that protects a quantum computer's fragile states by spreading each logical qubit across many physical ones and fixing errors as they happen. It hums with a steady, careful rhythm. Its lights blink in careful patterns.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Qubits decohere constantly. Error correction encodes one logical qubit in many, so errors can be detected and undone. I combined a quantum processor with an error-correction lattice on spacetime casing.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Femtoengineering.
